# Chattydesk

> Desktop AI chat client with multiple model backends, conversation history and model comparison.

## Endpoints
- Homepage: https://chatty.nevatal.id/
- API: https://chatty.nevatal.id/api/v1/
- API Catalog: https://chatty.nevatal.id/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent Card: https://chatty.nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-card.json
- AI Catalog: https://chatty.nevatal.id/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- Authentication Guide: https://chatty.nevatal.id/auth.md
